player_intent: Reloading stays visible and continuous through every movement technique. It ends only when the authored reload finishes or a fire click interrupts it to shoot ammunition already available in the magazine.
acceptance_rule: Standing, crouch, prone, sprint, jump, dive, roll, vault, and landing cannot cancel or restart an active reload. The magazine-in cue commits ammunition exactly once. A fire click with at least one chambered magazine round cancels the reload before the weapon processes that same shot; an empty magazine cannot cancel its required reload. Authored completion ends the reload normally.

nodes.role: Owns reload generation, fire interruption, ammo commit timing, and authored completion.
Consumes the authored magazine-in frame and emits one presentation timing cue without writing ammunition.
Keeps one accepted reload clip on one masked upper-body playhead while the continuous lower-body graph changes posture or mobility state underneath it.

system_delta.reason: Replace movement cancellation, posture-specific visual restarts, and the unconditional recovery trigger lock with one continuous upper-body reload timeline. Keep the existing magazine-in transaction, but let a fire click with remaining ammunition request the sole coordinator to cancel before the weapon processes that shot.

current.system: Reload timeline cancelled by displacement movement and locked against all fire

candidate.system: Movement- and posture-persistent authored reload with one uninterrupted upper-body playhead and accepted fire interruption

visual_check: In main.tscn, begin one reload and move through standing, crouch, prone, sprint, jump, dive, roll, vault, and landing without restarting its playhead. Let it finish once. Then begin a partial-magazine reload and click fire before the magazine-in cue; the reload must cancel and that click must fire one remaining round. An empty-magazine fire click must leave its reload running.
